captions.linkedin:
Most traders chase noise. The disciplined ones just follow the trend. 📈

TIME-SERIES MOMENTUM — one of the most studied strategies in systematic trading.

Here's the complete logic. No black box:

🔹 Signal — for each market, look at its own past 12-month return. Positive → go long. Negative → go short. You trade the sign of the trend, not a prediction.

🔹 Sizing — every position is scaled inversely to its volatility, so a calm bond future and a wild energy contract each carry the same risk. No single market can dominate the book.

🔹 Diversification — designed to run across 58 futures markets: commodities, equity indices, bonds and currencies. Uncorrelated trends, one mechanical rulebook.

🔹 Rebalance — monthly. Fully systematic. Zero discretion, zero forecasting, zero emotion.

It's the trend-following engine documented in peer-reviewed finance research (Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen, Journal of Financial Economics, 2012) and studied across more than a century of market data.
